tomcritchlow.com: The library is a rich collection of attributed excerpts. Archive and query views repeat entries; deduplicate quotes before sampling.
thejaymo.net: Weeknotes and research posts use substantial excerpts. Some source documents are long SEC filings; choose a range of topics and quote lengths.
interconnected.org: Strong essay context around substantive quotes; includes recent posts and older essays.
aaronzlewis.com: Four substantial quotes from two sources in the sampled essay. More posts need checking before assuming regular use.
subpixel.space: Thoughtful essay excerpts from several sources. Some original links use older HTTP URLs or a Mirror publication.
sonyasupposedly.com: Reading notes and essays provide substantive excerpts. Source availability and paywalls need checking.
warrenellis.ltd: Multiple externally attributed excerpts in the Isles collection. Category pages repeat individual posts.
brendanlangen.com: Several substantive excerpts, including Steven Johnson and Andy Matuschak. Substack sources may need access checks.
cagrimmett.com: The sampled weeknote explicitly describes using Quotebacks and contains two useful source-linked excerpts.
velcro-city.co.uk: Two substantial excerpts from one essay source. Expand to more posts before drawing conclusions about volume.
michaeldempsey.me: Substantial technical and strategy excerpts. Some citations point to the author's own notes subdomain, so external-domain counts overstate independent sourcing.
blog.numericcitizen.me: Newsletter excerpts include ordinary blog posts and Micro.blog conversations. Prefer complete original articles over timeline replies.
donfoolery.com: Several short attributed news and arts excerpts. Sources include commercial news publishers; verify full-text availability.
sensedoubt.blogspot.com: Substantial attributed excerpts, with repeated and republished material. Check originality of selections and avoid duplicate reference quotes.
swoods.net: One substantive externally attributed excerpt verified. Larger-scale curation quality remains unassessed.
writingslowly.com: One substantial excerpt verified; it contains a nested quotation. Track the immediate cited page and any underlying attribution separately.
dozenialdragons.me.uk: One substantive quote on the About page. This establishes an embed, but ongoing quote curation was not observed.
coincenter.org: Six substantive embeds observed, all citing other Coin Center pages. Useful for document-to-excerpt pairs, but these are same-publisher citations.
ictineducation.org: Terry Freedman / ICT & Computing in Education
One substantial embed quoting the author's own earlier article. Same-author selection rather than independent curation.
nesslabs.com: Embeds are demonstrated in a Quotebacks tutorial; regular use elsewhere was not established. One example is a social post.
kickscondor.com: Two embeds in a discussion of Quotebacks. The author says they normally prefer native blockquotes; treat these as examples, not evidence of regular use.
discursive.adamprocter.co.uk: One substantive excerpt in a post explicitly trying the Quotebacks feature. Regular use was not established.
sasamat-1.appspot.com: A single test quote appears on the post, homepage, and archive. These are one selection, not three independent quotes.
gunnar.se: A short 25-word description of Quotebacks is embedded. No substantive source excerpt found in the bounded crawl.
evan.blot.im: A five-word test quotes the author's other blog. This confirms integration but provides little evaluation value.
manton.org: One short same-author podcast announcement was observed in several archive views. The official blogroll lists this site; further post discovery is needed.
mirhuang.com: A substantial literary excerpt links to an Avidly / Los Angeles Review of Books essay. The old amyhuang.work domain redirects here; count this publisher once.

collect.readwriterespond.com: Search-indexed first-person discussion describes historical Quotebacks use and later CSS alternatives. The crawler could not access the pages, so current embeds are unverified.
bix.blog: A historical source archive appeared in Quotebacks searches. It now redirects to slow.dog; current use was not confirmed.
notado.substack.com: Search results mention Quotebacks. The original pages were blocked or unavailable to this crawl; no live embed was verified.
distroid.substack.com: A digital-gardens issue appeared in Quotebacks searches. The page was unavailable to this crawl; this is a mention lead, not confirmed use.
bmannconsulting.com: Several posts discuss Quotebacks and transclusion. No embed was found in the sampled pages.
reeswrites.com: A post discusses Quotebacks as a way to preserve quoted material. A mention alone does not establish use.
johnwhiles.com: The author built a Quotebacks plugin for Marked. This is integration evidence, but no published embed was found in the sampled pages.
rtl.chrisadams.me.uk: Chris Adams / Reads, Takes and Links
A Wagtail project-template post discusses Quotebacks integration. No rendered embed was observed.
publishing-project.rivendellweb.net: A WordPress implementation tutorial contains code examples. Code snippets were excluded from embed detection; ongoing use was not established.
jplattel.nl: An Obsidian clipper article mentions Quotebacks. No embed was found in the sampled pages.
frankmcpherson.blog: A 2020 post describes the Quotebacks tool. No embed was found in the sampled pages.
canion.blog: The archive mentions Quotebacks. Published embeds were not verified in the bounded sample.
adactio.com: A Quotebacks tag and related bookmarks were found. The sampled pages link to the tool but did not contain detected embeds.
notes.baldurbjarnason.com: Several notes discuss Quotebacks. The sampled excerpts use other markup; actual Quotebacks embeds were not verified.
notes.treasurechest.design: A digital-garden note mentions Quotebacks. No embed was found in the sampled pages.
links.weirdnet.org: A links archive mentions Quotebacks. This is a possible curator to inspect, but use was not established.

sepiabrown.github.io.reason: Sampled posts mirror Tom Critchlow's content; this is not counted as an independent curator.
sepiabrown.github.io.comparison_rule: Exact text intersection of HTML p elements whose rendered text exceeds 80 characters.

amyhuang.work.reason: Redirect target checked separately and genuine embeds confirmed; do not count both domains as separate curators.
